app.error.initFailedBody: The screen could not be prepared, so the app will close. Please start it again. If this keeps happening, check the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
app.error.startFailedBody: The component that draws the screen (Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime) could not be started. It is included with Windows 11. If it is missing, for example on Windows 10, install the WebView2 Runtime from Microsoft's download page.
app.notice.invalidJson: A document that cannot be read as JSON cannot be opened in the table or tree view. Fix it in the text view.
app.notice.duplicateKey: A document with duplicate keys is limited to the text view, because the table and tree views would drop one of them.
app.notice.depthExceeded: A document that is nested too deeply is limited to the text view.
app.notice.tooLargeForText: A document larger than 10 MB cannot be opened in the text view.
app.notice.scanFailed: The document could not be inspected, so the view was not changed.
app.notice.numericKeyReorder: This document has keys made only of digits. Editing and saving it in the table or tree view may change the order of the keys.
app.notice.openBlockedModal: Close the open dialog, then open the file.
app.notice.openBlockedBusy: Another operation is in progress. Try again when it has finished.
app.notice.replaceFailed: The document could not be replaced. Open another file again.

app.notice.refused.undecodable: The file cannot be opened because its character encoding could not be determined.
app.notice.refused.textOnlyTooLarge: Of the documents larger than 10 MB, those with invalid JSON, duplicate keys or excessive depth cannot be opened.
app.notice.refused.changedWhileReading: The file changed while it was being read. Open it again.
app.notice.denied: This file cannot be opened. Choose it again with the dialog or by dropping it.
app.notice.recentMissing: The file was not found, so it was removed from the history.
app.notice.settingsBroken: The settings file was broken. It was kept under a .broken name, and the app runs with the default settings.
app.notice.settingsUnwritable: The settings cannot be saved. This location is not writable, so changes last only for this session.
app.notice.locked: The file cannot be opened because another app is using it.
app.notice.failed: The file could not be read (code {{code}}).
app.notice.dropOneFile: Only one file can be opened. The first file will be opened.
app.notice.targetInvalid: The table target no longer exists, so the view went back to the whole document.
app.notice.externalReloaded: Another app changed the file, so it was reloaded.
app.notice.externalMissing: The file you had open can no longer be found. When you save, you will be asked whether to create it again.
app.notice.textEditorSelf: The default app for text files (.txt) is JsonGridder, so the file was not opened. Choose another default app for .txt in Windows Settings.
app.notice.textEditorFailed: The text editor could not be started (code {{code}}).

app.save.writeDenied: Writing to the file is not permitted. Save it under another name.

app.save.locked: Another app is using the file, so it cannot be written (code {{code}}). You can save it under another name.
app.save.blocked.modalOpen: Close the open dialog, then save. Edits inside the dialog do not enter the document until you apply them.
app.save.blocked.busy: Another operation is in progress. Try saving again when it has finished.
app.save.blocked.replaceFailed: Saving is stopped because the document could not be replaced. Open another file again.
app.save.staleRevision: The document changed while you were choosing where to save, so it was not saved.
app.save.recoveryNeeded: Saving failed, and the original file could not be restored to its original name. The original content is at: {{path}}
app.save.backupLeftAfterSave: Saved. The set-aside file remains at: {{path}}
app.save.eolNormalized: Saved. Mixed line endings were made consistent.
app.save.unpairedSurrogate: The document contains a broken character, so it cannot be saved.
app.save.serializationMismatch: Saving was stopped because the written content does not match the document. The file has not changed.
app.save.serializationFailed: The document cannot be written out, so it cannot be saved. The file has not changed.
app.save.verifyFailed: Saving was stopped because the written content could not be verified. The original file has not changed.
app.save.targetAppeared: Saving was stopped because a file with the same name appeared at the destination. Save again.
app.save.denied: Saving to this file is not permitted. Save it again under another name.
app.save.noDocument: There is no document to save.

app.settings.translation.title: Translation Settings
app.settings.translation.enableHint: When disabled, nothing is sent for translation. When enabled, you still confirm the number of values and characters before anything is sent.
app.settings.translation.freeTierNotice: With this key, the text you send and the translations are used to improve Google's products, and people may read them. Translate values that contain confidential or personal information with the paid key.
app.settings.translation.paidTierNotice: Use a key from a project with billing enabled. What you translate with this key is not used to improve Google's products. Whether you are on the free tier or paid is decided by Google from whether billing is enabled for the key's project, not by this app.
app.settings.translation.regionNotice: In the EEA, Switzerland, and the UK, only the paid API may be used.
app.settings.translation.legacyKey: Earlier key (choose where to move it)
app.settings.translation.legacyHint: A key saved by an earlier version is still stored. Choose whether it is the free-tier key or the paid key and move it. It is not used for translation until you move it. You can also leave it as it is.
app.settings.translation.needsKey: Save a free-tier key or a paid key to translate.
app.settings.translation.fallback: Switch to another model when the model is busy
app.settings.translation.fallbackHint: When the chosen model is busy or has reached its rate limit, the rest is sent with the next model in the list, for that translation only. The saved model does not change. Models can differ in price and quality.
app.settings.translation.confirmHint: Before each translation, shows the number of values, the characters, the service, the model and whether the free-tier or paid key is used, and asks before sending. Turn this back on after choosing "Don't show again".
app.settings.translation.machineNotice: Show the note in the result panel
app.settings.translation.machineNoticeHi: Shows the note that translations are machine guesses in the result panel. Turn this back on after choosing "Don't show again" in the panel.
app.settings.translation.error.empty: The key is empty. Paste the API key.
app.settings.translation.error.tooLong: The key is too long. Check what you pasted.
app.settings.translation.error.badCharac: The key contains characters that are not allowed (spaces, line breaks, or non-ASCII characters). Paste only the API key.
app.settings.translation.error.store: Could not read or write the Windows Credential Manager. Try again.
app.settings.translation.error.notSaved: The key was not saved. Reading it back right after saving did not find it in the Credential Manager. Save it again.
app.settings.translation.error.settings: A setting has a value that is not allowed. Choose again.
app.settings.translation.error.noLegacy: There is no earlier key to move.
app.settings.translation.error.occupied: A key is already saved there. It is not overwritten. Delete that key first, then move.
app.settings.translation.error.unknown: Could not read or write the translation settings.
app.translate.nothing: There is no text to translate. Numbers, true/false, null and empty strings are not sent.
app.translate.machineNotice: The translations are machine guesses, and rows can be mixed up. Check them against the original before you use them.
app.translate.machineNoticeNotSaved: Could not save "Don't show again". The note will be shown again next time.
app.translate.chooseTier: The saved keys have changed. Right-click again and choose free tier or paid.
app.dialog.translateBody: Send {{count}} values from {{source}} ({{unique}} after removing duplicates, {{chars}} characters) to {{service}} (model {{model}}) with the key for: {{tier}}.
app.dialog.translateFreeTierWarning: This is the free tier. What you send is used to improve Google's products, and people may read it. Do not send confidential or personal information.
app.translate.confirmNotSaved: Could not save "Don't show again". The confirmation will be shown next time.
app.dialog.translateBusyBody: Another translation is running. Stop it and start the new one? The translations done so far will be replaced in the side panel.
app.translate.panel.title: Translation
app.translate.panel.waiting: Waiting {{seconds}} seconds before sending again (rate limit or service trouble).
app.translate.panel.waitingOverloaded: {{model}} is busy. Waiting {{seconds}} seconds before sending again.
app.translate.panel.waitingQuota: {{model}} has reached its rate limit. Waiting {{seconds}} seconds before sending again.
app.translate.panel.finishedPartly: Finished. Some rows were not translated.
app.translate.panel.finishedBlocked: Finished. Some values were refused by the safety filter. Rewording them, or choosing another model in Options > Translation settings, may help.
app.translate.panel.cancelled: Cancelled. The rows translated so far are kept.
app.translate.panel.addColumn: Add translations as a new column
app.translate.panel.added: Added column {{column}} to {{count}} rows. Undo takes it back.
app.translate.panel.addSkipped: {{count}} rows were left out (no translation, the value changed, or not an object).
app.translate.panel.addNone: No row can take the column (no translation, the value changed, or not an object).
app.translate.panel.addTextMode: The column cannot be added in the text view. Use the table or tree view.
app.dialog.translateAddPartialBody: {{done}} of {{total}} rows are translated. The new column is added only to those rows, not to rows without a translation.
app.translate.error.disabled: Translation is off. Turn it on in Options > Translation settings.
app.translate.error.noKey: There is no API key for the chosen tier. Save the key in Translation Settings.
app.translate.error.storedKey: The saved API key contains characters that cannot be used. Enter it again in the translation settings.
app.translate.error.target: Translation into this language is not available.
app.translate.error.settings: The translation settings are not valid. Choose them again in the translation settings.
app.translate.error.tier: The choice of free tier or paid is not valid. Choose again from the right-click menu.
app.translate.error.busy: Another translation is running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it, then try again.
app.translate.error.noItems: There is no text to translate.
app.translate.error.duplicateId: The list to send is not valid. Try again.
app.translate.error.tooMuch: This is more text than can be sent at once. Translate a smaller part.
app.translate.error.store: Could not read the Windows Credential Manager. Try again.
app.translate.error.thread: Could not start the translation. Try again.
app.translate.error.key: The API key is not valid. Check it in Google AI Studio and enter it again in Options > Translation settings.
app.translate.error.permission: Google refused the request: the Gemini API is not enabled for the key's project, the free tier is not available in your region (EEA, Switzerland, UK), there is a billing problem, or the key was disabled. Check it in Google AI Studio.
app.translate.error.model: The model {{model}} was not found. Choose another model in Options > Translation settings.
app.translate.error.quota: The rate limit was reached. A per-minute limit resets after a short wait. The daily limit resets at midnight Pacific Time. To keep going, choose another model in Options > Translation Settings, or translate with the paid key (a key from a project with billing enabled).
app.translate.error.overloaded: {{model}} is busy (a temporary spike in demand at Google). Try again later, or choose another model in Options > Translation settings.
app.translate.error.allOverloaded: Every model is busy (a temporary spike in demand at Google). Try again later.
app.translate.error.allQuota: Every model has reached its rate limit. A per-minute limit resets after a short wait. The daily limit resets at midnight Pacific Time. To keep going, translate with the paid key (a key from a project with billing enabled).
app.translate.error.service: An error occurred in Google's service. Try again later.
app.translate.error.network: Could not connect. Check that you are online, and check the proxy and firewall settings.
app.translate.error.malformed: Could not read the response from the service. Try again.
